m920117.……すまない王子、逃してしまった。: …I'm sorry, Prince, we let him get away.
m920117.……そ、それでは、第二回戦の開始です！: …Well then, let the second round begin!
m920117.……そういうわけだったのですね。\n確かに、見知らぬ者の力に不安を抱くのは、\n: …I see. It's understandable to be uneasy about unknown power.
m920117.……それ故に、シュシュの集落や、\n私の集落の者が言葉を重ねても、\nそれを信じ: …Because of that, even if Shushu's settlement and mine keep saying the same thing, there will always be those who don't believe us.
m920117.……ですが、国民の投票では実力が無くとも、\n名声や人柄から選出された者も居るの: …but some settlements are questioning the choice, saying that even without real ability, people were picked for fame or personality.
m920117.……はっ、そうとなれば、\n急いで長老に報告をしてきますね！\nそれでは、また後: …Well then, I'll hurry and report to the Elder! See you later!
m920117.……クゥイルちゃん？\nクゥイルちゃんじゃないですかー！\nお久しぶりですー♪: …Quill-chan? It's you, Quill-chan! Long time no see! ♪
m920117.……世界樹の？\nも、もしかして、世界樹に何かおきたんですか！？: …A guardian of the World Tree? Could something have happened to it?!
m920117.……話には聞いていましたが、妖怪の方々の\n賑やかさは凄いですね。勢いに飲まれて:
…I'd heard about it, but the youkai's liveliness is amazing.
I'm getting swept up in the momentum.
Indeed, this could make for an ideal mock battle.
m920117.……随分と仲が良いですね。\n友達がいて羨ま……あっ、いえ、なんでもないです。: …You two are really close. I'm jealous of having friends… Ah, never mind.
m920117.……驚きました。王国では山賊が、\n我々に勝るとも劣らない実力を持っているのです: …I'm surprised. In the kingdom, bandits possess skill on par with ours.
m920117.『恨み猫三味線』おそるべし、ですね……。\nいえ、むしろこの曲の中でありながら、: “Vengeful Cat Shamisen” is terrifying, indeed… No, rather, perhaps we should be praising you, Your Highness, for fighting so hard within that very song.
m920117.『本来の力が出せない状況』を作るのに、\nうってつけの方がこちらにいますからね。: We have just the right person here to create a “situation where you can't use your true power.”
m920117.『災厄』の前兆という可能性は、\n捨てきれないですけどね……。: We can't rule out the possibility that this is a prelude to the “disaster”…
m920117.あっ、いえ、大変申し上げにくいのですが、\n今回は別件なのです……はい……。: Ah, no… It's a bit awkward to say, but this isn't about that… that's all.
m920117.あっ、ちょっと、手を離して、あぁっ！？: Ah, wait, let go of my hand, ah!?
m920117.あっ、ちょっと！\nもうバラさないでって言ったのに……。: Hey, stop spilling the beans already…!
m920117.あっ、で、でもご迷惑ですよね……？\n王国軍には腕利きの精鋭が既に大勢……って、: Ah… but this must be a bother, right? The kingdom already has plenty of elite troops… Huh? Wh-what…!?
m920117.あの、王子殿下……後ほどお話をよろしいですか？: Um, Your Highness… may I speak with you later?
m920117.あの兵器の力、間近で見極めタイ。\n私もこの戦い、参戦スルゾ！\n我が雷槍の力、: I want to see the power of that weapon up close. I'll join this fight too! Let me show the power of my thunder spear once more!
m920117.あの見慣れぬ兵器……マサカ、\nゴブリン達が自ら発明したというのカ？: That unfamiliar weapon… Masaka, did the goblins actually invent it?
m920117.あら、照れ隠しでしょうか？: Oh, are you just being coy?
m920117.あら、騎乗している上に弓も使える、\nあたし達の方が速度では上ではないかしら？: Ah, riding and shooting arrows—maybe we even have the edge in speed?
m920117.あら？ でもマリーベルさんったら、\n王子と模擬戦だからって、\n向こうではすご: Oh? But Maribel, you were so eager in the mock battle with the Prince over there, weren't you?
m920117.ありがとうございます、バシラさん。\n話の続きは周囲の魔物を討伐してからにしまし: Thanks, Bashira. Let's finish clearing the monsters first, then we can continue the talk. Prince, you're in charge of the battle!
m920117.あれはノーブルグリフィン！？\n他のグリフィンよりも知性が高く、\n非常に敵対心: That's a Noble Griffin! It's more intelligent than other griffins and a very hostile monster. Be careful!
m920117.い、良いんですか？ 本当ですか！？\nあ、ありがとうございます、王子殿下……！！: Is… is it okay? Is it really true!? Th-thank you, Your Highness…!!
m920117.いいえ、シュシュ。\nここまでの真の強さを見せつけられては、\n私自身も全力を出: No, Shushu. Having seen your true strength up to this point, it would be rude not to give my all myself.
m920117.いえ、そんな。\n妖怪の方々との連携があってこそでしたし……。: No, not at all. It was only thanks to our coordination with the youkai…
m920117.いえ、長老の話では、\n本当に『災厄』の時が来たら、\nこの程度の規模では済まな: No, according to the elder, if the real “disaster” comes, it won't be settled at this scale.
m920117.いえいえ、とってもすごかったですよー！\nこれなら世界樹にいずれ訪れるとされる、: No, no, it was incredible! With this kind of skill, we'll be fine even when the foretold “Calamity” hits the World Tree. ♪
m920117.いやいや、その王子達に突っ込んでいった、\nクゥイルも中々のもんさ。: No, no, you went right at those princes yourself—pretty impressive, Quill.
m920117.うぅ、他の集落さん達の意見なのですか……。\nあ、王子さまは初耳かもですけど、世: Oh, so that's the other settlements' opinion… Prince, you might not have heard this, but the World Tree is home to many different settlements and races!
m920117.うぅぅ、寒ぃ……。訓練って言ってもよぉ、\nこんな寒い場所まで来る必要あったのか: Ugh, it's cold… Training or not, did we really have to come to a place this freezing?
m920117.うっせぇ狐と猫！\nコンラッド達が戦ってたの見てうずうずしてたんだよ！: Shut up, you fox and cat! Watching Conrad and the others fight got me all riled up!
m920117.うん。きのこの化け物マイコニド以上に強力な、\n身体を蝕む胞子をばらまくヤツだよ: Yeah. It's stronger than the mushroom monster Myconid, spreading spores that eat away at your body.
m920117.えぇ、鬼気迫る表情、\n戦いの熱情の中に見える冷静さ、どれをとっても\n英雄譚に: Indeed—your fierce expression, the calm within the heat of battle—each was the very stuff of legend.
m920117.えぇっ！？ 納得いかないわ……。\nもう一回勝負よ、王子！:
What!? I can't accept this... 
One more match, Prince!
m920117.えっ、いや、しかし私には任務が……。: Eh, but I have a mission…
m920117.えっ？ クゥイルちゃん王国に来るんですか？\nやった！ やーりまーしたー！！\n:
Eh? Quill-chan, you're coming to the kingdom?
Yes! I did it!!
Ah, leave the guiding to me!
m920117.おそらくは……。連中には、\nゴブリン博士なる知恵者がいるとのことです。: Probably… They say there's a wise one called Goblin Doctor among them.
m920117.おっと、ちょっと止まって。\nこの気配……うん、間違いない。\n敵が近付いてきて:
Hold up, wait a sec.
This presence… yeah, no doubt.
The enemy's getting close.
m920117.おや本当に。\nこれは武者震いというより、\n楽しくて仕方ないってぇ震え方だねぇ: Oh my, indeed. This isn't trembling from fear, but the kind of shaking that comes from pure enjoyment.
m920117.お恥ずかしい……つい熱くなってしまいました。\nけれど、王子殿下の戦いぶり、\n:
I'm embarrassed… I got all worked up.
But Your Highness's fighting was truly wonderful.
m920117.お昼ごはん！ お昼ごはんは大事ですよ！\nクゥイルちゃんも一緒にごはん食べません:
Lunch! Lunch is important!
Quill-chan, want to eat together?
m920117.くっ、逃げる気か……！: Damn, are you trying to run away…!
m920117.こ、こらシュシュ！ 抱きつかないでください！\n私はお側で戦えたらと言っただけで:
Hey, Shushu! Don't hug me!
I only said I'd love to fight by your side,
and I never said I wanted to come to the kingdom…!!
m920117.こいつは負けちゃいられねぇな。\nおい野郎ども、あっちで模擬戦の続きだ！: I can't afford to lose to this guy. Hey, you lot, the next mock battle's over there!
m920117.こちらにも多数の負傷者がいます。\n深追いは悪手でしょう。仕方ありません。: We have many wounded here as well. Pursuing further would be a bad move. It can't be helped.
m920117.この猛攻まで凌ぐとは、\nやはり王子殿下こそ英雄の器と言えそうですね。: To withstand such a fierce onslaught… indeed, Prince truly has the makings of a hero.
m920117.こほん。王子殿下の実力はよく分かりました。\nしかしまだまだ、こんな物ではないは: Ahem. I've got a good sense of Prince's abilities. But that's not all there is to you yet! Show me even greater power!
m920117.これが逃亡に見えルのナラ、\nどうとデモほざくが良い、名も知らぬ竜人ヨ。: If you think this looks like a retreat, say whatever you like, nameless dragon-folk.
m920117.これだけの防衛能力を誇る者を、\nいとも容易く突破するとは……。: To break through someone boasting such defensive power so easily...
m920117.これで『災厄』ではないとは、\n本物の『災厄』とは、\n果たしてどんなものなので: So this isn't the “Calamity”… I wonder what the true “Calamity” actually looks like…
m920117.これはたぶんアルラウネだ。\nうぅ、厄介だなぁ……。:
It's probably an Alraune.
Ugh, what a nuisance…
m920117.これより私は世界樹へ戻り、\n長老にこの模擬戦の結果を報告いたします。: From here I'll return to the World Tree and report the results of this mock battle to the Elder.
m920117.こんなお方のお側で戦えたら、\nどれだけ素敵でしょうね……。:
If I could fight by someone like that,
how amazing that would be…
m920117.さぁて、それじゃあ\n争う力を奪う恨みの一曲『恨み猫三味線』\n聴いてもらおうか: Alright then, shall I have you listen to the vengeful tune “Vengeful Cat Shamisen” that steals away the power of conflict, Your Highness?
m920117.しかし、いざという時に\n窮地に駆けつけられてこそ真の英雄。: But a true hero is one who can rush to the rescue when the time comes.
m920117.すごいすごいですー！\n王子さま達はこんな風に、\n世界の平和を守っていたんです: Amazing, amazing! So the Prince and his companions keep the world safe like this!
m920117.すごかったよ、王子。\nこっち側から王子を見るのは久々だから、\nちょっとどきど: You were amazing, Prince. It's been a while since I've seen you from this side, and it got my heart racing.
m920117.そ、そうでしょうか……？\n褒められると、少々気恥ずかしいものが……。\nうぅぅ: I-… really? Being praised makes me a bit embarrassed… *cough*
m920117.そうそう、グリフィンさんもクゥイルさんも、\nとても素敵だったと思うよ……？: Yeah, both Griffin-san and Quill-san were just wonderful… right?
m920117.そうそう、分かってくれて助かるよ。\n何しろ向こうの方から、\n魔物の足音が聞こ: Exactly, glad you get it. We can already hear monsters' footsteps coming from that side!
m920117.そうだね。\nよぉーし、訓練の続きもがんばろー！:
Yeah.
Alright, let's keep pushing with the training!
m920117.そうですよー！\n王国の皆さんで、英雄に相応しい実力と人望を\n備えた人を投票し: That's right! The kingdom voted for someone with both the skill and the reputation to be a hero!
m920117.そうですよ？ さぁ向こうで親交を深めましょう？: That's right, isn't it? Come on, let's strengthen our friendship over there?
m920117.そこで、グリフィンの騎兵である私と\n私の仲間達で、直接王国軍の力を測るべし、\: So my griffin cavalry and my comrades decided we'd test the kingdom's forces directly.
m920117.そして、その命を受けた一人であるシュシュが\n貴殿らの元を訪れ、英雄に相応しい兵: And Shushu, one of those chosen, has visited you and selected soldiers worthy of a hero.
m920117.その『災厄』がいつ訪れるのか、\n前もって分かれば良いのですが……。: If only we knew when that Calamity would come…
m920117.その実力、実績、多くの者に慕われる人望、\n確かにあなたこそ『災厄』を振り払う、: Your skill, your record, the respect you command—surely you are the very vessel of a hero who can drive away disaster.
m920117.その為に王国軍内でも\n高い耐久力を誇る方々に、助力を願いました。: For that, I've asked the kingdom's most durable warriors to lend us their aid.
m920117.それから、吹雪が起きている間は視界が遮られて、\n飛び道具が届きにくくなっている: Also, while the blizzard rages, visibility is low and ranged attacks are harder to land. Keep that in mind for long-range attacks.
m920117.それであたし達、\n神官戦士を選んだっていうわけね。: So that's why we chose the priest-knights, huh?
m920117.それでは、これにて模擬戦は終了です。\n皆さんお疲れだと思いますので、\nしっか:
That concludes the mock battle.
You all must be exhausted, so be sure to get plenty of rest.
m920117.それでは、私以下、世界樹より同行した仲間と共に、\n全力で模擬戦に参加させていた: Then, together with my companions from the World Tree, I'll give my all in the mock battle!
m920117.それでは小休止を挟んでから、\n次の模擬戦に移りましょう。: Then let's take a short break before moving on to the next mock battle.
m920117.それでは少し休憩を挟んでから、\n実戦訓練を続けましょうか。休憩中も、\n周囲の:
Then let's take a short break, and after that continue the combat drills.
Even during the break, don't let your guard down around us, okay?
m920117.それでは模擬戦の前半をここで終了し、\n休憩にいたしましょう。\n後半に向けて、:
Then we'll end the first half of the mock battle here and take a break.
Please recover your strength for the second half.
m920117.それでは次の模擬戦に移りましょう。\n王子、呼吸を整えておいてくださいね。: Then let's move on to the next mock battle. Prince, steady your breathing.
m920117.それならば、クゥイルさん達を交えた模擬戦で、\n我々の実力をみていただくのはいか: Then how about a mock battle with you, Quill, and your group so we can show our strength?
m920117.それに、こういう環境だと、\n魔物が足場の悪さを利用してくるかもしれないしね。: Besides, in this kind of environment, monsters might use the slippery ground against us.
m920117.それにしても、魔王軍は\nいったい何を企んでいるのでしょうか……。\n今後も警戒: Still, what on earth is the Demon King's army plotting…? Let's stay on guard, Prince.
m920117.それに何より、彼らを退ける王子の武技と指揮。\n模擬戦の続きがより一層楽しみにな: And more importantly, the Prince's martial prowess and command in repelling them. I'm even more excited for the next round.
m920117.それに加え、王子ノ腕も落ちるドコロか、\n更に磨きがかかっていた。\n次の戦いが: And on top of that, the Prince's skill seems to be sharpening. I'm looking forward to the next battle!
m920117.だーいじょうぶですよ♪\nだって王子さま達がいるし、私達もいますから、ね♪: Don't worry♪ Because the Prince and everyone are here, and we're here too, right♪
m920117.ちょーっと待った！ 一度休憩にしましょ。\nせっかく縁が出来たんだし、\n一緒に:
Hold on a sec! Let's take a break.
Since we finally got to know each other,
how about we have lunch together?
m920117.つまり、機動力のある私達の出番ということですね。\n可愛らしいクゥイルさんが\n: In other words, it's our turn to show off our mobility. Seeing the cute Quill watching really pumps us up, doesn't it?
m920117.つまり俺達は、\n全力で王子にぶつかっていけばいいんだな？: So… we just have to go all-out against the Prince, right?
m920117.つるつるーって滑ってきたり、とかですよね！: Like slipping on the ice—“slippery~” and all!
m920117.ですから最後のこの一戦は、\n一騎の武人として、王子殿下の胸を借りたく思います。: So for this final bout, I wish to fight as a lone warrior, borrowing the Prince's resolve.
m920117.でも、こうして色んな場所で戦闘を重ねると、\n自分の欠点も見えてくるね。\nまだ:
But the more we fight in different places,
the more our flaws become clear.
We've still got a lot to work on…
m920117.ともかく、王子殿下の交友の広さには、\n深く感心いたしました。\n妖怪の方々とも: In any case, I'm deeply impressed by the breadth of your friendships, Your Highness. To have such close ties with the youkai…
m920117.なぁるほど、得心がいったよ。\nそれであたしを探してたのかい、ご主人。:
I see, that makes sense.
So you've been looking for me, Master?
m920117.ならば、我が全身全霊の一撃をもって\n挑むよりほかにはありません……ッ！！: Then I have no choice but to challenge you with my all-out strike…!!
m920117.なるほど……。それでは王子、\nアルラウネ、マイコニドに注意して戦いを進めましょ: I see… Then, Prince, let's watch out for Alraune and Myconid as we fight.
m920117.なるほど、魔物相手とはいえ、\n確かに素晴らしい戦いぶりですね。: I see… Even against monsters, your performance was truly remarkable.
m920117.ねっ♪ 王子さま達ってすごいですよね～♪: Right♪ Prince and the others are amazing~♪
m920117.はぁ……模擬戦、模擬戦ねぇ……？\nま、やるんなら全力でやってやろうか！: Sigh… a mock battle, huh? Well, if we're doing it, I'll give it my all!
m920117.はい♪ クゥイルちゃんは私のお友達で、\n世界樹を守護するグリフィンの騎兵さんな: Yes♪ Quill-chan is my friend, a griffin knight who protects the World Tree.
m920117.はい、さすがはシュシュが見出した方々です。\nしかし、次の模擬戦は簡単にはいきま: Indeed, as expected of those discovered by Shushu. But the next mock battle won't be easy!
m920117.はい、英雄には強力な敵を押し留め、\n守るべき者を守る力が求められる、\nと言い: Yes. Heroes are expected to hold back powerful foes and shield those they must protect.
m920117.はい。その投票――人気闘兵の結果と報告は\n聞き及んでいます。: Yes. I've heard the results of that popularity-battle vote.
m920117.はい。模擬戦とは言え、全力でお願いします。\n手を抜くような行為は――: Yes. Even though it's a mock battle, give it everything you've got. Holding back…
m920117.はっ！？ うっ……うぅぅ……。\nさすがは山賊です。なんて耳聡い……。:
Huh!? Ugh… uuu…
As expected of a bandit. Such sharp ears…
m920117.ひとまずはお疲れ様でした、王子。\nいつ予言の瞬間が訪れても対応できるよう、\n: For now, good job, Prince. Let's keep training enough so we can handle the moment the prophecy arrives, whenever that may be.
m920117.ふぅ、何とかなったね♪\nさっすが王子、やーるぅ♪:
Phew, we made it through♪
As expected of you, Prince—awesome!
m920117.ふぅ～、いい感じだったね♪\n皆の連携も上手くいった気がするし！:
Phew— that felt good♪
I think everyone's coordination went smoothly too!
m920117.ふふ、如何に王子がお強くても、\n私達には癒やしの力がありますものね。\n傷を癒: Hehe, no matter how strong the Prince is, we have the power of healing. We'll mend wounds and get back on our feet.
m920117.ふふん、頼りにしてるわシプリア。\n王子に勝ったら美味しい甘味を食べに行くわよ！: Heh, I'm counting on you, Cypria. If we beat the Prince, let's go get some tasty sweets!
m920117.へっ、なるほどな、普段と違う状況でこそ、\n出来る訓練もあるってわけか。: Heh, I see. Different conditions bring different training opportunities.
m920117.へっ、身内同士で言い争ってんなよ。\nオレは王子の兄貴にイイトコ見せられるかもっ: Huh, stop bickering among yourselves. I'm so excited because I might get to show off something cool to the Prince's older brother.
m920117.ほら、私はもう腹ペコなんだ。\n文句を言わずに付いてくる付いてくる。:
Look, I'm already starving.
Don't complain—just follow me, follow me.
m920117.まぁ、何にしたって野放しにはしておけない。\nまずはこの周辺を探って――:
Well, whatever it is, we can't let it run wild.
First, let's scout the area—
m920117.まぁ確かに、一流の武人である王子と\n刃を交えるとなれば、同じく武を志す者として: Well, it's true—facing a first-rate warrior like the Prince makes anyone who aspires to the sword feel a thrill.
m920117.まだまだ貴殿の、\n底の知れない実力を見せていただきますよ！: I'll continue to witness the depth of your limitless power!
m920117.まっ、確かに速度なら私達が最速よね。\nいくら王子でも、騎兵の速度には追いつけな: Well, when it comes to speed, we're definitely the fastest. Even the Prince can't keep up with cavalry speed.
m920117.もしかして、\n長老さんが予言した『災厄』なのでしょうか？: Could it be the “disaster” the elder prophesied?
m920117.もちろん、良いともさ。\nご主人達の力になれるっていうならね。:
Of course, gladly.
If I can be of help to you masters, then yes.
m920117.もとより、明日から王国軍の訓練として、\n模擬戦を行う予定でしたから。\nそうで: We were already planning to hold a training mock battle starting tomorrow, weren't we, Prince?
m920117.もはや貴殿らの実力に、\n疑う余地など一片もありません。: There isn't the slightest doubt left about your abilities.
m920117.やはり、王子殿下の実力は本物。\n相手にとって不足なし。:
As I thought, Your Highness's skill is genuine.
No shortage on the opponent's side.
m920117.よろしいのですか……？ 助力を頼む皆様に礼を欠くような\nお願いですが……王子殿: Is that alright…? It feels like a selfish request from those asking for help, but thank you so much for agreeing, Your Highness.
m920117.わ、私も頑張りますから。\n他の集落の子には負けませんよ！: I—I'll do my best too. I won't lose to the kids from other villages!
m920117.ギャギャッ！ 王子！ ミツケタ！: Gya gya! Prince! I found it!
m920117.クゥイルちゃん、王子さまのことべた褒めですねぇ♪\nクゥイルちゃんが本気で戦う姿:
Quill-chan, you're really laying on the Prince's praises, aren't you♪
I finally got to see Quill-chan fight seriously after such a long time!
m920117.クゥイルちゃんは謙遜しすぎー！\nばさばさーってカッコよかったよね？: Quill-chan, you're being way too modest! You were so cool, slicing through everything!
m920117.クロコ……！！\nテメェ、ヨクも顔を見せられたナァ！:
Croco…!!
You finally showed up, huh!
m920117.クロコ様、先程の飛行物体、\nこちらの方へ飛んでいった様です。: Lord Croco, that flying object just now seems to have flown this way.
m920117.クロコ！ テメェまた逃げルつもりカ！？: Croco! You planning to run away again!?
m920117.グリフィンの弓騎兵……。\n弓の射程とグリフィンの機動力を備えた兵のようですね。: Griffin mounted archers… Soldiers that combine bow range with griffin mobility, it seems. Prince, please command so the rear units aren't targeted!
m920117.ケイティさんの言うとおりです！\nもっともっともーっと！ 頑張らなくちゃですね！:
Just as Katie-san says!
More and more—let's give it our all!
m920117.ケッ、悪巧みしてるっテ、\n自分で言ってるようなもんダゼ。\n能書きは良いから掛: Hah, you think you're scheming, huh? It's like you're admitting it yourself. Enough with the talk—just come at me already!!
m920117.ケッ、魔王に尻尾振った腰抜けのことダ。\nドウセいけ好かネェ陰謀に決まってやがる:
Hah, those cowards who wag their tails for the Demon King.
It's obviously some despicable conspiracy.
m920117.コハルさんがこの辺りを漫遊していると、\n東の国の方から聞いたものですから。\n:
We heard that Koharu-san has been wandering around these parts, from the eastern country.
Could you help us with the training…?
m920117.シュシュが懐くのも分かるというもの。\nならば私が、直接実力を見極めましょう。: No wonder Shushu's taken a liking to her. Very well, I'll judge your strength myself.
m920117.シュシュさん、お知り合いなのですか？: Bashira, are you acquainted with her?
m920117.シュシュに先に紹介されてしまいましたが、\n私はクゥイル、世界樹の守護を担う者の: Though Shushu introduced me first, I'm Quill, one of the World Tree's guardians.
m920117.マイコニドとアルラウネの異常増殖だけでなく、\nノーブルグリフィンまで現れるなん: Not only the abnormal surge of Myconids and Alraunes, but even a Noble Griffin showing up…
m920117.ライラちゃん、何だか嬉しそうじゃない？\n嫌々参加したようには見えないなぁ。: Lyla-chan, you look kind of happy, don't you? You don't seem like you were forced to join.
m920117.ラミィ、それは鳥じゃなくてグリフィン。\n私達はグリフィンの騎兵さん達と一緒に、:
Ramii, that's not a bird, it's a griffin.
We'll be teaming up with the griffin cavalry to face the Prince.
m920117.一人前の山賊頭になれたかどうか、\nここらでひとつ、王子の器を見極めてやるか。: Let's see if you've truly become a proper bandit chief. I'll test the Prince's mettle right here.
m920117.世界の平和というか、\n今回は王都周辺の警備ですけどね。: Well, it's more like guarding the capital area this time, but yeah, world peace and all that.
m920117.今回は手ごわい魔物も現れなかったし、\n割と余裕だったな。: That was pretty easy—no tough monsters showed up, so we had plenty of room to breathe.
m920117.何かを企む、と言うよりも、\n各地で何者かを探している様子だったらしい。: Rather than plotting, it seems they're searching for someone across the lands.
m920117.元々、この辺りの魔物の調査は\n近い内にと予定していましたからね。\nこれもちょ: We originally planned to investigate the monsters around here soon, so this is a perfect opportunity, don't you think?
m920117.先程は奇襲を仕掛けて申し訳ありません。\nしかしあの激突で、\n貴殿らの実力が確: I'm sorry for launching that surprise attack earlier. But that clash showed me that your strength is truly solid.
m920117.先程は見事な戦いでした。\nでは攻撃の腕は如何ほどでしょうか？: That was a splendid fight earlier. Now, how about your offensive skills?
m920117.全力が出せない中でも流石ですね、王子殿下。\nですが、妖怪ばかりでなく、私たち\: Even though you can't give it your all, you're still impressive, Your Highness. But I'll show you that not only the youkai, but also our World Tree troops are not to be underestimated.
m920117.別件……？\n王子、ひとまず落ち着いて\n話の出来るところへ行きましょうか。: Another matter…? Prince, let's calm down and head somewhere we can talk.
m920117.十分な休息がなければ、訓練の効果は半減します。\nそれに、世界樹と王国間の\n親:
Without sufficient rest, training effectiveness is cut in half.
Besides, deepening the bond between the World Tree and the kingdom is an important mission too, isn't it?
m920117.協力ありがとうございます、コハルさん。\nまた、訓練に際して他の妖怪の方にも声を:
Thank you for your cooperation, Koharu-san.
Also, we've called in some other youkai for the training.
They should arrive shortly—
m920117.吹雪と足場の悪さが重なって辛いかとは思いますが、\nこれも訓練の一環です。\n王: The blizzard and the bad footing must be tough, but it's all part of the training. Prince, let's do our best together!
m920117.器の見極めを抜きにして、\n武人としてぶつかり合いたいということですね。\nふふ: Skipping the assessment and just clashing as warriors, huh? Heh, my arms are itching.
m920117.報告にあったのはこの辺りでしょうか。\n世界樹周辺の魔物が活発化している、\nと:
Is this the area mentioned in the report?
It said monsters around the World Tree have become more active, but…
m920117.報告の際、私も王子殿下の道行きに助力したいと、\n長老に申し出ようかと思っていま: When I report, I was thinking of offering my assistance on your journey to the Elder…
m920117.守護と攻撃、\n貴殿らの戦闘能力は十分見せていただきました。: Guarding and attacking, I've seen enough of your combat abilities.
m920117.守護の力は十分に見せていただきました。\nなれば次は、突破するための破壊の力を\: We've seen enough of your protective power. Next, I'd like to see the destructive force you use to break through.
m920117.実は今回、私が王子殿下を訪ねたのは、\n世界樹の各集落の要請によるものです。: Actually, the reason I came to see you, Prince, is because each settlement of the World Tree has requested it.
m920117.弱い部分があるからこそ、\n日々の訓練が欠かせないのですよ？: That's exactly why daily training is indispensable, right?
m920117.弱キ者ホド、ヨク吠えるものだナ……。\nシカシ王子、残念だが今日は相手をしてやれ:
Weaklings bark a lot, don't they... 
Anyway, Prince, sorry but I won't be entertaining you today. I'm both a warrior and a subordinate of the Demon King.
m920117.強くなったよねぇ、王子。\nあたし達も負けていられないね！: You've gotten stronger, Prince. We can't afford to lose either!
m920117.悔しいのは分かりますが、\nこれは完敗ですよ。疑いようもなく。: I understand you're frustrated, but this is a total defeat. No doubt about it.
m920117.我が山より天狗達も呼んである。\nこちらにとっても良い修行となることだろう。:
I've even summoned the tengu from my mountain.
It'll be good training for us too.
m920117.我が配下の者ドモヨ、\nしばらく王子達を足止めしてオケ。: My subordinates will hold you and the others off for a while.
m920117.数が増えると胞子の濃度が高くなるから、\n早目に倒すように心がけてね。: As their numbers grow, the spore concentration rises, so try to take them down early.
m920117.最後の模擬戦は、これまでに見せていただいた、\n英雄の器に必要である、\n全ての: For this final mock battle, I will challenge you, Prince, with every element of a hero's worth that I've witnessed so far.
m920117.次から次へと……訓練し放題ね！\n王子、環境に適応している魔物も\nいるだろうか: One training after another… we can train endlessly! Prince, some monsters have adapted to the environment, so stay on guard.
m920117.次が最後の模擬戦です。\n世界樹の守護を担うグリフィンの騎兵として、\n全力の私: The next battle will be the final mock fight. As a griffin cavalryman defending the World Tree, I will throw my full power at you, Your Highness!
m920117.準備は良いですか、王子殿下。\nそれでは……行きますよ……ッ！！: Are you ready, Prince? Then… here I go…!!
m920117.王国の皆様も知ってのとおり、\n世界樹の集落を取りまとめている長老が、\n『世界: As everyone in the kingdom knows, the elder who oversees the World Tree's settlements has prophesied a coming disaster...
m920117.王子……強かった……すごい……楽しい……。: Prince… you were strong… amazing… so much fun…
m920117.王子……戦う……楽しい……頑張る……。: Prince… fighting… fun… I'll do my best…
m920117.王子、これが最後の模擬戦です。\nクゥイルさんに、私達の全力をお見せしましょう！: Prince, this is the final mock battle. Let's show Quill everything we've got!
m920117.王子、みんな、\n今日は修行に付き合ってくれてありがとね！: Prince, everyone, thanks for joining the training today!
m920117.王子、クゥイルさんは強力な攻撃を準備している様子。\n先手を打った方が良いかもし:
Prince, Quill seems to be preparing a powerful attack.
It might be best to strike first… Take great care!
m920117.王子、魔王軍のデーモンが出現しました。\nどうやら応戦するしかなさそうです。\n: Prince, a Demon from the Demon King's army has appeared. It looks like we have no choice but to fight. Quickly, prepare for battle!
m920117.王子、魔王軍の竜人、\nクロコが目撃されたという地点に到着しました。: Prince, we've arrived at the spot where the Demon King's dragonfolk, Croco, was sighted.
m920117.王子とは随分とご無沙汰だったしな。\nちょっと、稽古つけてやるとしようか。: It's been ages since I've seen you, Prince. Let me give you a little training.
m920117.王子とやるのは久々だからな。\n腕が鳴るってもんだぜ。: It's been a while since I've faced the Prince. My arms are itching for a fight.
m920117.王子と一緒に修行だって聞いたから、\n急いで飛んできちゃったー！ なになに？\n: I heard you were training with the Prince, so I swooped over right away! What's this? A bird…? Should I zap it?
m920117.王子よ、お前昔よりずっと強くなってんじゃねぇか？: Prince, you've gotten a lot stronger since before, haven't you?
m920117.王子殿下、参ります！\n我が奥義、超えてみせて下さい！:
Your Highness, I'm coming!
Let me show you my ultimate technique!
m920117.王子殿下、間近にて\n英雄たる貴殿の武勇を見せていただき、\n本当にありがとうご: Your Highness, being so close and witnessing your heroic valor has truly been an honor. Thank you.
m920117.王子殿下の器、そして王国の皆様の実力は、\n見極めさせていただきました。: Prince, I have assessed both your capacity and the kingdom's strength.
m920117.王子！ た、叩きのめしてあげるから、覚悟しなさい！: Prince! I'll beat you down, so brace yourself!
m920117.王都周辺の巡回も神殿前で最後ですね。\n皆さん、魔物の討伐お疲れ様でした。: This is our last patrol around the capital before the temple. Everyone, great job on the monster hunt.
m920117.申し遅れました。私は世界樹の――: My apologies for the abrupt introduction. I am… a guardian of the World Tree—
m920117.目まぐるしく移り変わる戦闘に対応出来てこそ、\n本物の強者であると言えるでしょう: Only those who can adapt to ever-changing battles can be called real strong.
m920117.相手をしてやる暇ハ無いと言ったノダ。\n王子ヨ、再戦は別の機会に預けさせてもらオ: I told you I have no time to play with you. Prince, we'll leave the rematch for another time.
m920117.確かに『真の英雄ならば、\n本来の力が出せない状況であっても、\n抗ってみせるこ: Indeed, they said “a true hero must resist even when unable to unleash their true power,” but…
m920117.確かにね。\n私達も訓練を積んでいるからさ、\n任せておいてよ王子。: That's right. We've been training, so leave it to me, Prince.
m920117.私は魔王様に報告を急がねばならヌ。\nさらばだ王子、次の戦いを心待ちにしてイルゾ: I must report to the Demon King immediately. Farewell, Prince—I'll be eagerly awaiting our next fight!!
m920117.私を下したとなれば、他の集落の者達も、\nもはや王子殿下の実力を疑うことはないで: Now that I've been bested, the people of other settlements will no longer doubt your abilities.
m920117.空から鳥……いえ、あれはっ！\n王子、グリフィンに女の子が乗っています！: A bird from the sky… no, look! Prince, there's a girl riding a griffin!
m920117.粉骨砕身、貴殿の指揮下で\n空を駆けることを誓います……！！: I pledge, with every bone and breath, to soar through the skies under your command…!!
m920117.純粋な耐久力なら私達の方が上よ？\nたとえ王子でも、\nこの全員を楽に倒せるなん: If it's pure durability, we're the ones who're better. Even you, Prince, don't think you could easily take down all of us at once.
m920117.見事な戦いでした。\n空からの奇襲にも対応出来るとは、\n練度の高さがうかがえま: What a splendid fight. To think you could handle an aerial ambush—your skill is truly impressive.
m920117.足場の悪い状況での訓練は重要でしょう。\nいざこういう場所で戦う事になった時、\: Training in poor footing is important. When we actually have to fight in such places, having experience can change the battle.
m920117.騎兵諸君の速度自慢は結構だけど、\n身軽さも忘れてもらっては困るな。: Your cavalry's bragging about speed is fine, but don't forget about agility.
m920117.魔王軍め、こんな所で\nいったい何を企んでいるんだ？: The Demon King's army—what on earth are they plotting here?
m920117.魔王軍幹部トシテ並び立つ強者探シ、\n飽いてキタところだったガ、興が乗っタゾ！: I've been bored searching for strong foes to stand alongside the Demon King's officers, but now I'm excited!
m920117.鳥っていうより、空飛ぶ獣ね。\nまずいわ、こっちに向かってくる……！！: It's more of a flying beast than a bird. This is bad, it's coming right at us…!!
m920117.（うぅ、否定はしません。\nむしろお人好し過ぎるくらいです……）:
(I won't deny it.
If anything, they're way too nice…)
m920117.（ねっ、クゥイルちゃん。\n王国の皆さんって、\nとーってもいい人達ですよね♪）:
(Hey, Quill-chan.
Everyone in the kingdom are really wonderful people, aren't they♪)

m920120.――あ、あの、お邪魔しますっ！\n突然すみません、あなたがこの村に住まうという、: ――Ah, um, sorry to intrude! I'm sorry to appear out of the blue, but are you the famed feng-shui master who's said to live in this village...?
m920120.――あっ、王子様！ こっちです！\nお待ちしておりました！: ――Ah, Prince! Over here! We've been waiting for you!
m920120.――いや待て。\nこの先に何者かが待ち伏せしているぞ。: ――Hold on. Someone's lying in wait ahead.
m920120.――えっ？ あなたが王子だったの？\nへぇ……ふぅん……悪くないじゃない。: —Huh? You're the Prince? …Hmm… not bad at all.
m920120.――なるほど、カリンさんの村のわらべうた、ですか。: ――I see, so it's Karin's village nursery rhyme.
m920120.――はいっ！\nハクタク様……どうか、どうか私達に、\n病を祓う力をお貸しくださ: —Yes! Hakutaku-sama… please, please grant us the power to cleanse this disease…!!
m920120.――ふむ、やはり連中、\nオレ達の研究施設の場所へまっすぐに向かっていくな。: —Hmm, as expected, they're heading straight for our research facility.
m920120.――むっ、でも素直に伝承の地まで\n行くことは出来そうにないですね……。: —Hmm, but it doesn't seem like we can just head straight to the Land of Legends honestly….
m920120.――オークども、今回は大人しく引き下がりな。\nお前たちの病はあたしらの仕業では: —Orcs, this time just stand down. The illness isn't our doing, and you'd rather not waste your strength fighting a battle you can't win, right?
m920120.――カリンさん。\nもしや、ハクタクの声が聞こえるのですか？: —Karin-san. Could it be that you hear Hakutaku's voice?
m920120.――ヌハハハハッ！！ 残念だったなァ！！\nハクタクなどという、唯のおとぎ話に踊: ――Nuhahaha!! What a pity!! To be fooled by a mere fairy tale like Hakutaku!
m920120.――ハクタク。なるほど、確かに。\nこの病も、幻獣ハクタクであれば\n治せるかも: ――Hakutaku, huh? That makes sense. If it's the legendary beast Hakutaku, perhaps it could heal this illness. That's a blind spot we missed.
m920120.――ヘぇ、侵入者ありと聞いて誰かと思えば、\n何だ、王子と愉快な仲間達じゃないか: —Heh, I heard there was an intruder and wondered who it might be. Well, it's the Prince and his merry companions. You're quick to sniff me out.
m920120.――大丈夫です、カリンさん。\nハクタクの呼び声に応え、その名を呼んでください。: —It's all right, Karin-san. Answer Hakutaku's call and invoke his name.
m920120.――成る程、話は聞かせてもらいました。\n自信が無いのなら、\n自信が付くように:
—I see, I've heard the story.
If you lack confidence, the only way is to train until you gain it, right?
m920120.――狛天君、何という体たらくだ。\n重病人相手に敗北し、戦場から逃げ去るとは。\: Komaten, what a pathetic excuse for a warrior. Losing to a bedridden fool and fleeing the battlefield—he's not even a mad dog, he's a loser.
m920120.――風水？ それにあの装い……。\n間違いありません。\nきっとあの女の子が、か: ――Feng Shui? And that outfit… No doubt about it. That girl must be the famed Feng Shui master…!!
m920120.…………ど、どどど、どうしましょう！？\nさっきから頭の中に、\nハクタク様が話: ………W-what should I do?! Ever since a moment ago, Hakutaku-sama has been speaking to me…!?
m920120.…………は、はい。\n危険なのは百も承知です！\n先日の旅で思い知りましたから！: …Y-yes. I'm fully aware how dangerous it is! I realized that on our recent journey!
m920120.…………はい。私に付いてきてくれるそうです。\n良かった、これで子供たちや皆の病:
………Yes. He said he'll come with me.
Good, now we can cure the children's and everyone's ailments!
m920120.……あ、あの。カリンさん、わたしも以前、\n王子様たちの道案内をした事があるので: …Um, Karin, I also once guided the Prince and his party…
m920120.……あら、カリン先生じゃない。\nこんな所でどうしたの？ 何か悩み事？:
…Oh, it's Teacher Karin.
What brings you here? Something on your mind?
m920120.……いいえ、こいつら、子供を誘拐していたから。\n本当はわたしだけでも十分だった: ???: …No, those guys were kidnapping children. Honestly, I could've handled it alone, but I'll thank you anyway. —Thank you.
m920120.……いえ、ここは見逃す他に手はありません。\nこのままでは私達の症状も進行するば:
…No, we have no choice but to let them go.
If we keep this up, our own symptoms will only worsen.
In the next clash, we might not even be able to fight properly…
m920120.……いえ、私も連れて行ってください。\n私が離脱したら、\n道案内をする者がいな:
…No, take me with you.
If I leave, there'll be no one to guide the way.
m920120.……えっ？ ハクタク様は子供のおとぎ話ですよね？\n確かに実在するのなら、森羅万: …What? Hakutaku is just a children's story, isn't it? If it really existed, its wisdom that spans all of creation could surely banish any disease…
m920120.……おやぁ？ とうとう病の熱に浮かされて、\n在りもしない物が見える様になりまし: …Oh? Have you finally been driven mad by fever, seeing things that don't exist?
m920120.……ここが正念場ですね。\n王子、尊天君が纏う宝貝『禍血陣』は\n周囲の者を切り: …This is the critical moment. Prince, the treasure Sonten bears, the “Calamity Blood Formation,” turns surrounding sand into razor-sharp blades—a solid defensive array.
m920120.……ごほっ、今回は、言う通り引き上げるとしよう……。\n次は互いに万全の状態で戦: …Cough, fine, we'll withdraw as you said. Next time, let's both be at full strength before we clash…
m920120.……その余裕ぶった態度、\n相変わらずですね、迅天君。: …That smug attitude of yours is still the same, Jinten.
m920120.……その姿、呪術師だな？\nはっ！ まさかこの病は貴様の呪術によるものか！？: …That figure… a sorcerer, right? Ha! Could this plague be your magic?!
m920120.……では、どういう、ことですか？\nこほっ、ここがハクタク様が住まう地であるのな: …Then what does that mean? If this truly is where Hakutaku lives, why are you ignoring Jasen's actions…?
m920120.……なるほど、そういうことでしたか。\nハクタクとは心正しき者にしか姿を見せない: …I see, that makes sense. Hakutaku only appears to those with a pure heart. No matter how the Evil Immortal searched, it could never be found.
m920120.……ふふ、ありがとうございます。\nでは、私も伝承の地までの道案内の役目を\nし: …Heh, thank you. Then I'll fulfill my role as guide to the Land of Legends properly!
m920120.……まぁ、そういうわけだ。\n悪い奴じゃない。ちょっと変わってはいるけどな。: …Well, that's how it is. She's not a bad person. A bit odd, though.
m920120.……わかりました。\n皆さん、わらべうたによれば、\nこちらの方角へ進めば伝承の:
…Understood.
According to the children's song, if we go this way we'll reach the legendary place.
m920120.……ネヴィン、助けてとは言ってないんだけど。: ???: …Nevin, I never asked you to save them.
m920120.……何とか、退けられましたね。\nしかしこのままでは、\nいたずらに体力が削られ:
…We managed to push them back.
But if we keep going like this, we'll just waste our stamina…
m920120.……先程、実験と言いましたか？\nこほっ……子供達を、村の人達を苦しめて、\nこ: …You just called that an experiment? *cough* Tormenting the children, the villagers… you call this an experiment…?
m920120.……厄介な状況ですが、死中にこそ活路もあります。\nここで邪仙を倒し、華の国に平: …A troublesome situation, but even in death there is a way out. Let's defeat the evil sage here and restore peace to the Land of Flowers! Prince, command us to victory!
m920120.……歴史上で、ハクタクが観測された事は事実です。\n邪仙とは言え、仙人の端くれで: …Historically, there have been observations of Hakutaku. Even you, half-immortals of the Jasen, should know that.
m920120.……物事はそう単純なものではないが、\n確かに自信を持つことは大切だ。\nそして: …Things aren't that simple, but having confidence is important. And getting to know your comrades' strength, too.
m920120.……物取りにしては、随分と体調が悪そうですね。\nもしや彼らも件の病を患っている: …For a loot-seeker, you look pretty sick. Could they be suffering from the same illness?
m920120.……狼狽えるでない。ここでハクタクを捕らえれば、\nその力を超える病の宝貝すら作: …Don't lose your composure. If we capture Hakutaku here, we could even forge a disease-warding treasure that surpasses its power. Futen-kun, see this as a golden opportunity!
m920120.……王子、兵の中にも\n身体の異変を訴える者が続出しています。\nもしや、私達も: …Prince, even among the troops, many are reporting strange ailments. Could it be that we too have contracted that disease—
m920120.……迅天君は去ったみたいです。\n無理をしないで、カリンさん。\n邪仙に言葉を投:
…It looks like Jinten has left.
Don't push yourself, Karin.
There's no point shouting at the Evil Immortal…
m920120.あ、あの、王子殿下……。\nひとつお願い事をしても良いでしょうか……？: Ah, um, Your Highness… May I ask a favor…?
m920120.あ、ご、ごめんなさい。\n私は東の方の村から来ました、カリンと申します。\nこの: Ah, I-I'm sorry. I'm Karin, from the village to the east. I heard a renowned feng-shui master was here…
m920120.あ、それでしたら向こうで王子達が\n訓練をしていましたから、\n模擬戦の協力をお: Ah, if that's so, the Prince and the others are training over there, so we'll ask them to help with the mock battle.
m920120.あぁ、メイファちゃんか……。\n最初は老人だけだったんだが、げほっ、ごほっ、\n: Ah, Mei-Hua-chan… At first it was only the elders, cough, cough, and now we're in this condition too…
m920120.あっ、あぁっ！ あなたは隣の村のおじさま！\nまさか隣村もそんなことになっている: Ah, ah! You're the gentleman from the neighboring village! I can't believe the neighboring village is in the same state…
m920120.あといくつか、邪仙の病の気が\n残っている地域がありますので、\nその気を祓い終: There are still a few areas where the evil disease lingers; once I've cleansed them, I'll return right away.
m920120.あなたは……邪仙、迅天君！\nこの地に踏み込んでからの皆さんの体調……。\nやは: You are… the Evil Immortal, Jinten! Ever since you stepped onto this land, everyone's health has deteriorated… So the plague spreading in the Flower Kingdom is your doing?
m920120.あの、本当にありがとうございました、王子殿下！\nおかげで私の教え子達もすっかり: Um, thank you so much, Your Highness! Thanks to you, my students have fully recovered.
m920120.あの扇から……とても強い病毒の力を感じます。\n風水の力でも……けほっ、けほっ！: From that fan… I feel an incredibly strong viral power. Even feng-shui… *cough* *cough*! It's a wicked force beyond anything we could counter…
m920120.あら、でも最初の頃よりずっと、\nハクタクとの連携がうまくなっているわ。\nさす: Ah, but you've gotten a lot better at coordinating with Haku-taku than you were at the start. As expected, Professor Karin.
m920120.あれ見てよ。あのダークエルフが、\n闇の組織の連中を追い詰めててさ。\nもう一触:
Look at that. That dark elf is cornering the dark organization's guys.
It's about to explode.
m920120.あんなに辛そうだっていうのに、戦うつもりか？\n放っておくだけでも、次第に衰弱し: They look miserable, yet they still want to fight? If we just leave them be, they'll keep weakening and eventually collapse…
m920120.いいえ、ハクタクは滅多に姿を現さないだけで、\n確かに実在する幻獣ですよ。問題は: No, Hakutaku rarely shows itself, but it does exist as a legendary beast. The problem is that the location of its legendary dwelling is unknown…
m920120.いいや、貴様らが自らここへやってきたのだ。\nこの地こそ、伝承にあるハクタクの住: No, you all came here of your own accord. This land is undoubtedly the Hakutaku's dwelling of legend.
m920120.いえ、教師と名乗れるほど立派なものでは……。\n村には学校が無いので、私が子供達: No, I'm not distinguished enough to call myself a teacher… There's no school in the village, so I just teach the children arithmetic and letters.
m920120.いえ、邪仙の企みとあらば、遅かれ早かれ\n私達も関わることになっていたことでしょ: No, if it's the Evil Immortal's plot, sooner or later we'd have been drawn in anyway.
m920120.いやいや、感服したよ。\nそこまで病に蝕まれて、まだ先へ進めるとはね。: No, no, I'm impressed. To be so ravaged by the disease and still keep moving forward.
m920120.うぅ、癒し手さん達の魔法でも、\nこの病を治癒することはできないみたいです。\n: Even the healers' magic can't cure this disease. We were able to soothe the fatigue and weakness it causes, but…
m920120.うん。幹部らしき奴の姿も確認したよ。\nでも、ひとつ問題があって……。:
Yeah. I even saw someone who looked like a senior officer.
But there's one problem…
m920120.えっ？ えっ？ あ、あの……？\n皆さんどうしてそんな慣れた様子で\n模擬戦の準: Huh? Huh? Ah, um…? Why are you all so comfortable preparing for the mock battle…!?
m920120.おう、じ……？\nもしかして、あなたが王国の王子様なのですか！？\nお、王子様た: Huh…? Could it be… you're the kingdom's prince!? I can't believe I'm barging into a story about princes…
m920120.お医者様も尽力してくれているのですが、\n今の所、お医者様たちもわたしたち風水使: The doctors are doing everything they can, but so far all we healers and feng-shui practitioners can manage is to ease the weakening…
m920120.くっ……どうして……。\nどうしてこんなことを、するのですか……？: Damn… why… why are you doing this…?
m920120.くっ……ようやく狛天君を退けたと思えば、\n次は尊天君と淵天君だと……？: Ugh… I finally thought we'd gotten rid of Komaten, and now it's Sonten and Futen-kun?
m920120.ぐ、ぬぅ……病に侵された身体で、\nよくもここまで耐えるものだ……。\nここは、: Guh… ugh… with a body ravaged by disease, how can I still endure this far… I guess we have no choice but to withdraw…
m920120.けほっ……王子、不利な状況ではありますが、\nもはや退くことは出来ません。\n何: *cough* Prince, the situation is grim, but we can't retreat now. We must get through this by any means.
m920120.けほっ。王子様、わたし達風水士なら、\n体力の消耗を軽減することは出来ると思いま:
*cough* Prince, as feng shui masters we think we can lessen the stamina drain.
Please consider putting us to use.
m920120.けれど私は、ハクタク様の力をお借りしているだけで\n人々の力になれていないんじゃ: But I only borrow Haku-taku's power, and I worry I'm not really helping the people…
m920120.げほっ、ごほっ……む、村の皆が、\n病に臥せってしまって、薬代のために、\n症状: Cough, cough… All the villagers are bedridden with the disease, and to afford medicine we had no choice but to plunder the mildly afflicted…
m920120.ここが報告にあった、\n闇の組織の拠点のひとつか？: Is this one of the dark organization's bases the report mentioned?
m920120.ここは、遠距離からの攻撃を提案します。\n接近された者への撤退指示もご一考下さい: I recommend a long-range attack. Also consider ordering a retreat if he closes in. …ahem, Prince, stay vigilant.
m920120.この先に進むためには、\n邪仙の手下を退けるしか手はなさそうですね……。\n王子:
To move forward, it seems we have no choice but to drive back the Evil Immortal's minions…
Prince, the situation's dire, but please ready us for battle.
m920120.この場でハクタクに選ばれし者。\n――ハクタクが願いに応えるとすれば、\nそれは: Here stands the one chosen by Hakutaku. —If Hakutaku were to grant a wish, it would be none other than Karin-san.
m920120.この風景……こほっ、けほっ……。\nきっとここです、ここがハクタク様の伝承の地で: This scenery… cough, cough… This must be it, the legendary land of Hakutaku. But somehow… I feel even heavier than before…
m920120.こほっ、けほっ……むしろ、カリンさんのおかげで、\n邪仙の想定より早く、この事態: *cough* *cough* Actually, thanks to you, Karin, we were able to intervene earlier than the Evil Immortal expected.
m920120.こほっ、けほっ。……おとぎ話、夢物語？\n……いいえ。ハクタク様は、います。だっ: Cough, ahem… fairy tale, dream story? …No. Hakutaku-sama is here. Because…
m920120.こほっ、こほっ……この病、\nやはり邪仙の術に類するものでしたか……。: *cough* *cough* This disease… it really is some technique of the Evil Immortal…
m920120.こほっ、こほっ、狛天君に従っている道士の扇、\nあれが病を引き起こす宝貝みたいで: Cough, cough, the Taoist's fan that follows Komaten… it looks like the cursed treasure causing the disease…
m920120.これで一安心ですね、王子、カリンさん。\nそれでは、急いで道を戻りましょうか。\:
Now we can finally breathe easy, Prince, Karin.
Then let's hurry back the way we came.
The sooner we cure everyone's illnesses, the better.
m920120.こんなに辛そうなのに、\nそれでも症状の軽い方だなんて。\nどうやら事態は一刻を: They look so miserable, yet they're still among the less severe cases. It seems time is of the essence…
m920120.こんな距離からもう、\nオーク達の騒ぎ声が聞こえてくるな。\nいったい何が起きて: Even from this distance I can hear the orcs' commotion. What on earth is happening?
m920120.ごほっ、けほっ……。王子、狛天君が来ます……！\n彼の者が持つ『烈焔陣』は目標は: Cough, ahem… Prince, Komaten is approaching…! His “Raging Flame Formation” not only hits its target but also scorches everything around it.
m920120.ごほっ、げほっ……お、王子の仲間だったとは……。\n王国軍の手合いであれば、\n: Cough, cough… So you were allies of the Prince… If you were kingdom troops, you wouldn't resort to such underhanded tactics…
m920120.さて、皆さんもお疲れのようですし、\nそろそろ拠点へ戻りましょうか。\n今夜はカ: Well, everyone looks tired, so shall we head back to the base? Tonight's Karin's welcome party, after all.
m920120.し、新型宝貝の実地試験は既に十分ッ！\n撤退、撤退ですヨォ！！\n尊天君、しっか:
The field test of the new treasure shell is more than enough!
Retreat, retreat!!
Sonten, pull yourself together—we're leaving you behind!?
m920120.しかし、闇の組織の戦力は削ぐことが出来ました。\n何より彼女も無事なようですしね: Still, we managed to thin the dark organization's forces. And she seems to be okay, too.
m920120.しかしまぁ、知らない仲というわけでもない。\n我ら邪仙の次なる一手、\nどうして:
But it's not like we don't know each other.
As for the Evil Immortal's next move, if you really insist, I might tell you a thing or two.
m920120.しかし初の模擬戦とは思えない活躍だったな。\nこれは将来、化ける逸材かもしれない: But you all performed like it wasn't even a first mock battle. You might become a prodigy someday…
m920120.しかし安堵している暇はありませんよ。\n急ぎ人々の病を癒やしてあげなければ。\n:
But there's no time to rest.
We must hurry to heal the people's illnesses.
Will Haku-taku cooperate with us?
m920120.すみません、ネヴィンさん。\n別のご用事で訪ねてこられたのに、\nここまで同行し:
Sorry, Nevin.
I came for another errand, yet you've come all the way here with us…
m920120.すみません、私がハクタク様の伝承を話さなければ、\n皆さんまでこの病を患うことは: I'm sorry—if I hadn't told the legend of Hakutaku, none of you would have caught this disease…
m920120.ぜぇ……ぜぇ……ごほっ、\nか、金をだせぇ……ごほっ、げほっ！: Bandit?: Haa… haa… *cough* G-give us the gold… *cough* *cough*!
m920120.そ、そんなに褒められても困ります……。\nそれにハクタク様まで……そんな、うぅぅ: I-I'm embarrassed by all the praise… And even Haku-taku himself… ugh…
m920120.そう……でしょうか……？\nふふっ、それならあの子達の為にも、ちゃんと\n皆さん: I… guess so? Hehe, then for those kids I must properly guide everyone to the legendary land.
m920120.そういえばカリンさん、\nさきほど『教え子』と言っていましたが、\nカリンさんは: Speaking of which, Karin, you called someone a “pupil” earlier—are you a schoolteacher?
m920120.そうそう、その調子だ。カリン先生？\n先生が弱気じゃ、生徒まで弱気になっちゃうか: That's right, keep it up. Teacher Karin? If the teacher's weak-hearted, the students will be too!
m920120.そうだ。だからこそ我らはこの地を占領し、\n幾度も調査を行った。……だがハクタク: Indeed. That's why we occupied this place and conducted countless investigations. …Yet not only was there no Hakutaku, not even a trace of it existed here.
m920120.そうだったんですか……。どうしましょう、\n村の子供たちが薬の効かない病にかかっ: I see… What should we do? The village children have contracted this untreatable disease, and we hoped to enlist the master's help…
m920120.そうだったんですね……。\nてっきり架空のおとぎ話だとばかり……。: I see… I always thought it was just a fictional fairy tale…
m920120.そうなのですか……。\nでも、守られるばかりなのは少し申し訳ないですね。\n私も: Is that so…? Still, it feels a bit shameful to be protected all the time. I wish I could be useful beyond just guiding…
m920120.そうなんです。王国の癒し手の皆さんなら、\n何か解決法を知っているかもしれないと: Exactly. We thought the kingdom's healers might know a solution…
m920120.そして私の教え子達も、頑張れカリン先生と、\n笑顔で見送ってくれました。: And my students cheered me on, “Do your best, Teacher Karin!” with smiles as they saw me off.
m920120.その……本当に自信はないのですが……。\nそれでもよろしければ、王子殿下、\nよ: Well… I'm really not confident, but if that's okay, Your Highness, I'll do my best…!
m920120.そのとおり、必殺剣は一日にしてならず、\nハクタクの力を扱うのもまた然りってやつ: Exactly. A finishing sword isn't mastered in a day, and wielding Haku-taku's power is no different.
m920120.その後、皆を苦しめた病の気を祓うため、\n私はハクタク様と共に華の国を巡っていま: After that, to dispel the lingering disease that tormented everyone, I traveled the Land of Flowers together with Hakutaku-sama. I think we've finally reached a lull…
m920120.それが、満足に戦えないくらい不調になったせいで、\n病を持ち込んだ犯人探しに躍起: Exactly. They're so weakened they can barely fight, and now they're scrambling to find whoever brought the disease to them.
m920120.それじゃあわたしは、さらわれていた子供を\n元の街へ帰してあげなくちゃいけないか: Then I have to return the kidnapped child to their hometown. I'll be on my way. See you again, Prince?
m920120.それでは王子、\nカリンさんの教え子さんや華の国の皆さんを救う為、\n急いでハク: Then, Prince, let's hurry to the legendary Hakutaku site and save Karin's students and everyone in the Land of Flowers!
m920120.それでは王子殿下、\nこれからもよろしくお願いします！: Then, Your Highness, I look forward to working with you from now on!
m920120.それに幻獣の力をただ享受するわけではなく、\n幻獣と共に力をあわせるという戦い方: And it's not just about enjoying the phantom beast's power, but fighting together with it—there's still so much to learn…
m920120.それに死んでも何も失う物はないぞ？\nオレ達がキョンシーとして、\n有効活用して: Besides, there's nothing to lose even if we die. We'll repurpose you as zombies…
m920120.それはたぶん、お師匠様のことですね。\nすみません、今は各地の村を走り回っていて: That would be you, Master, right? I'm sorry, I'm traveling between villages right now, so I'm not actually in this one…
m920120.それは分かるけど……。\nじゃあどうするって言うんだよ……。:
I understand that, but…
So what are we supposed to do?
m920120.それは困りましたね……。\n密林の平和の為にも、放置はでき――: That's a problem... For the sake of the jungle's peace, we can't just leave it—
m920120.それよりカリン、君も邪仙の病を発症したんだろう？\n誰か護衛をつけて、メイファの:
More importantly, Karin, you've also contracted the Evil Immortal's disease, right?
You should get a guard and return to Mei-Hua's village—
m920120.そんな……このままでは教え子達が……。\nああ、おとぎ話のハクタク様が、\n本当: This can't be… If it continues, my students… If only the fairy-tale Hakutaku were truly here…
m920120.そんな……それでは、\n村の皆さんの病を治すことは……。: That… then we can't cure the villagers' illness…
m920120.そんなことを悩んでいたのね。いい？\nカリン先生は軍人じゃなくて、ついこの前まで: So that's what's been bothering you. Listen, you weren't a soldier—until just recently you were a teacher for the village children.
m920120.そんな人がいきなり戦場に出て、\n不安にならない方が不思議というものよ。: It's amazing that someone like you would suddenly appear on the battlefield without feeling uneasy.
m920120.だって……聞こえないのですか……？\nあ、あの、王子殿下にも聞こえますよね……？: But… can't you hear it…? Um, Prince… you can hear it too, right…?
m920120.ちっ、気付かれてしまったか……。\nだが、奴らが探しているのは病を流行させた犯人: Damn, they've spotted me… But they're looking for the one who spread the disease. If I can point out the culprit without fighting, maybe they'll leave us alone…
m920120.ちゃんと、ハクタク様の了承も得ています。\n正しき道を歩む限り、私を見守ってくだ: I've already gotten Hakutaku's blessing. As long as I walk the righteous path, he'll watch over me.
m920120.ちょうどいい。病の末期症状が如何なるものか、\n王子達の身体で実験させてもらうと: Perfect. I'll use the Prince and his companions' bodies to study the disease's final symptoms.
m920120.って、あ、あれ？ この娘って、私ですか！？\n……う、うぅ、分かりました。\n王: Wait, what? Is that… me?! …I… I understand. Prince, let me fight alongside you…!!
m920120.つまり、このまま一直線に\nハクタクの伝承の地へ向かうのが最善手、\nということ:
So the best move is to head straight for the legendary site of Hakutaku?
Is that right…?
m920120.つまり、特訓ですね？\nそれなら私達が付き合いますよ？: So, intensive training, right? If that's the case, we'll join you.
m920120.でもこのジャングルで、\nあんな病見たことないんだけどなぁ。\nいったい何が原因: But I've never seen a disease like that in this jungle before. What could have caused it?
m920120.と、ともかく急ぎましょう！\n風水の力では治せなくても、癒やしの魔法なら\n病を: Anyway, let's hurry! Even if Feng Shui can't heal them, a healing spell might fully cure the illness!
m920120.というのも、何もかもが華の国の文献にない症例で、\n治療方法が全く分からない状態: The thing is, there's no record of anything like this in any of the Land of Flowers' texts, so we have no idea how to treat it. It doesn't seem to be contagious…
m920120.どうする。このまま放っておけば、\nおそらくあのダークエルフひとりで、\n闇の組: What should we do? If we just leave it, that dark elf will probably end up battling the dark organization on his own.
m920120.どうやら、この騒動の発端は謎の病らしい。\nここ最近、オーク達の間で\n正体不明: It seems this whole uproar started because of a mysterious illness. Lately, an unknown disease has been spreading among the orcs.
m920120.どうやら、頼りになる仲間が増えそうですね。\n我々もこの拠点の調査をしてから、\: Looks like we'll be gaining a reliable ally. After we finish investigating this base, we'll head back to the kingdom.
m920120.どうやらこれで、密林の騒ぎは収まったみたいだな。: Looks like that settles the jungle disturbance.
m920120.な、成る程、確かにィ！ 病の気が祓われようと、\n宝貝自体は無力化されていません: I-I see! Indeed! Even if the disease aura is dispelled, the treasure itself remains intact! Let's infect the princes with the disease again and capture the girl!
m920120.なるほど……。\nそういうことでしたら、一層先を急ぎましょう。\n病が進行すれば: I see… In that case we need to move even faster. If the disease progresses, we can't even guess what'll happen—
m920120.は、はい……！ それから、その、王子殿下。\nハクタク様が殿下に伝えたいことがあ: Y-yes…! And, uh, Your Highness, Prince. Hakutaku-sama has something he wishes to convey to you…
m920120.は、はい。この地に来てから、最初は微かに……。\nですが、今は確かに、ハクタク様: Y-yes. When I first arrived it was faint… but now I can clearly hear Hakutaku-sama.
m920120.はぁ……はぁ……。\nな、何だか身体が重くなってきた気がします……。: Hah… hah… I feel my body getting heavy….
m920120.はい……。久方ぶりに現世に姿を見せたが、\nここまで純朴な心の持ち主は初めて見る: Yes… He mentioned that it's been ages since he showed himself in the mortal realm, and that he's never seen such a pure-hearted person before. To put it myself… it's a bit embarrassing.
m920120.はい……。現在華の国の一部で、\nこれまでにない病が広まっているんです。: Yes… A disease unlike any we've seen is spreading through part of the Land of Flowers.
m920120.はい。私の村ではハクタク様を祀っていて、\nその昔ハクタク様が降臨した際の逸話の: Yes. In my village we worship Lord Hakutaku, and the many anecdotes from when Hakutaku descended are preserved as nursery rhymes about the legendary land.
m920120.はい！ 病の宝貝の気が消えて、\nこの辺りの空気も綺麗になっていきます！: Yes! The cursed treasure's aura has faded, and the air around here is getting clean!
m920120.ははは、どうして、だって？\n君達の苦しそうに歪んだ顔を見ることが出来たんだ、\: Hahaha, why indeed? I got to see your twisted, suffering faces—just that was worth cooperating on the experiment.
m920120.はははッ、そんな強がりを言っていていいのかい？\n平静を装っていても、身体は正直:
Hahaha, can you really keep up that bravado?
Even if you pretend to stay calm, your body will tell the truth.
m920120.ははッ！ 何も出来ない小娘のくせに、\n表情だけは一人前か！\nまぁいい、少しだ: Hah! A little girl who can't do anything, yet her expression looks seasoned! Fine, I'll play with you a bit longer.
m920120.ひぁ……っ、こ、腰が抜けてしまいました……。\n私達、勝てたのですよね……？:
Hia… my… my legs gave out…
We won, didn't we…?
m920120.ふふ、お気になさらなくても大丈夫ですよ。\n王子も賛成のようですし、\nカリンさ: Hehe, don't worry about it. The prince seems on board, so Karin, could you guide us?
m920120.ふふ、そう好き勝手させると思ってるんですかァ？\nその前に、私の宝貝『棺氷陣』で: Heh, you really think you can do as you please? Before that, I'll freeze this battlefield with my treasure, the “Coffin Ice Formation”!
m920120.ふふ、模擬戦を通して\n良い連携が生まれつつあるみたいです。\n急な模擬戦でした: Hehe, it seems a good partnership is forming through the mock battle. It was a sudden exercise, but I'm really glad we did it.
m920120.へぇ……病に蝕まれた身体で、\nまだそんな力を残しているとは、実に興味深い……。: Huh… even with a body ravaged by disease, you still have that kind of power… fascinating.
m920120.へぇ、地上でダークエルフとは、珍し――って、あぁ？\nどうしてあいつ、あんな所に: Huh, a dark elf on the surface, that's rare—wait, what? How did that guy end up there?
m920120.へへっ、やっぱりカリンは『カリン先生』なんだな。\nよし王子、症状が重くなって動: Heh, so Karin really is “Teacher Karin.” All right, Prince, before the symptoms get worse and you can't move, let's reach the Hakutaku's dwelling spoken of in legend.
m920120.ま、ハクタク自体は世界のどこかに居るかもしれないが。\n少なくとも、この地に伝わ: Well, Hakutaku might exist somewhere in the world, but the legend passed down here is just a fairy tale—that's our conclusion.
m920120.ま、幻でしょうか……？\nか、カリンさんの隣に、\nいつの間にか動物さんが見える: Is… this an illusion? I seem to see an animal appear beside Karin-san out of nowhere…
m920120.ま、待って……待ちなさ――ひぐっ、\nはぁ……はぁ……どうしてこんなことを……。:
Wa—wait… wait—ugh, *gasp*,
ha… ha… why is this happening…?
m920120.まぁ、皆慣れてるからね……。\nよぉし、久々の王子との模擬戦。気合をいれて\n華: Well, everyone's used to it… Alright, a mock battle with the Prince after a long time. Let's show the power of the Land of Flowers, Professor Karin!
m920120.まぁ良い。病を患った弱者をいたぶるのも悪くないが、\n今はもっと興味深い実験の最:
Fine then. Tormenting the sick is fun enough, but I'm in the middle of a more interesting experiment right now.
I'll leave dealing with you to my subordinates.
m920120.まさかこれ程の被害とは……。\n老若男女問わず、病の発症状況は\n深刻な段階にあ: I never imagined the damage would be this severe... It seems people of all ages are already in a critical stage of the illness.
m920120.まだ断定はできませんが、邪仙の手によるものであれば、\n従来の薬や魔法、民間の治: I can't say for sure yet, but if it's the work of the Evil Immortal, conventional medicines, magic, or folk remedies won't be able to treat it at its root.
m920120.まったく、そんな戦闘もままならない状況で、\nどうして私達を襲撃したんだ？: Good grief, in a situation where we can barely manage combat, why did they attack us?
m920120.まったく、今日は王子と顔合わせだって言っただろう。\nそれがどうしてこんな所で、: Seriously, you said today you'd finally meet the Prince. How did we end up fighting the dark organization here on our own?
m920120.み、皆さんお強いのですね……。\nけれど王子殿下自ら前線に立たれるなんて、\nび: Y-you're all so strong… But to see Your Highness himself take the front line… I'm surprised.
m920120.んんー……。はぁ……。\nって、りゅ、竜吉公主様……っ！？\n……いえ、少し弱気:
Hmm… *sigh*.
Ah, L-Longji Gongzhu…!?
…No, I'm just feeling a bit down.
m920120.オーク達が病ですか……。\n体調を崩したのなら大人しくなりそうなものですが、\n: The orcs are sick...? If they're feeling ill they'd normally just lie down, but they're causing a ruckus?
m920120.カリンさんには、何か心当たりがあると言う事ですね。\n……手がかりの無いこの状況: So you think Karin might have some clue, right? …We're stuck without any leads. Prince, why don't we enlist Karin's help here?
m920120.ククク……ヌハハハハハッ！\nどうした王子、どうした王国の猛者どもよ、\n貴様ら: Kukuk… Nuhahaha! What's the matter, Prince, what's the matter, kingdom's champions—was that all the power you possessed!?
m920120.クックック……まぁ、良いじゃありませんか。\n何故なら、ここで私らが\n王子たち: Hehehe… well, that's fine. After all, this is where we finish off the princes!
m920120.クックック、人を信じすぎるのも考えものですネェ。\n人類の英雄たる王子様が、たか: Hehehe, trusting people too much is a dangerous habit, isn't it? The heroic Prince shedding his life on a mere village girl's fairy tale.
m920120.グァアアアアアッ！？\nハクタクめ……貴様が病毒を祓いさえしなければッ！\nこち:
Guaaa!?!
Haku-taku… if only you'd purged the virus! Our victory would've been certain…!!
m920120.セシリーさん、セブンさん、\n見張りお疲れ様です。この場に\n闇の組織が出入りし:
Cecily, Seven, thanks for the watch.
We heard the dark organization is operating here…
m920120.ネヴィンさんのお知り合いとあれば、\n見過ごすわけにはいきません。\n王子、あの: If Nevin's acquaintance is involved, we can't just turn a blind eye. Prince, let's go rescue him.
m920120.ハ、ハクタクですってェ……ッ！？\nくぅっ、周囲に張った病の気がかき消されていく: H-Hakutaku…! The disease aura surrounding us is being erased!?
m920120.ハクタクがあなたを認めたということでしょう。\nカリンさんが正しき道を歩む限り、: It means Hakutaku has acknowledged you. As long as you walk the righteous path, Hakutaku will surely lend you his power.
m920120.ハクタクの加護、魔祓いの力があれば、\n邪仙の術や魔法による攻撃を防ぐ事も可能で: With Hakutaku's blessing and exorcising power, we can even fend off attacks from the evil sage's techniques and magic. Prince, give Karin any orders she needs when the time comes.
m920120.ハクタクは歴史上、何度か病魔や災いを祓うため\nその姿を現しました。カリンさんの: Hakutaku has appeared throughout history to dispel plagues and calamities. The nursery rhyme passed down in Karin's village was likely woven at that time.
m920120.ハクタク様の住まう伝承の地……。\nもしかしたら、その場所にご案内出来るかもしれ: The legendary land where Hakutaku resides… Perhaps I could guide you there. I'm not entirely confident, though…
m920120.ハハッ、つまりそれが答えってヤツだろう？\n――ハクタクは実在しない、おとぎ話。: Ha! So that's the answer, huh? —Hakutaku doesn't exist; it's just a fairy tale. That's the answer we, the Jasen, have given.
m920120.ハハハッ！ まぁそういうわけだ。\nさて、それじゃあオレは別の任務に向かうとしよ: Hahaha! Well, that's how it is. Now I'm off to another mission. One seriously ill prince is more than enough, right? Brother Komaten.
m920120.フン、誰が兄貴だ。だが、ワシ一人で十分なのは確かよ。\n王子ども、ここでワシら邪: Hmph, who calls me brother? Still, I alone am enough. Prince, you'll serve as our Jasen's merit right here.
m920120.メイファさん、お待たせしました。\n華の国に異変が起きている、とのことでしたが…: Mei-Hua, sorry to keep you waiting. You said something strange is happening in the Land of Flowers…?
m920120.一緒に戦ってわかったと思うが、\n私達にも出来ること、出来ないことがある。\nそ: Fighting side by side shows us what we can and can't do. And for the things we're weak at, we should cover each other.
m920120.仮に連中が例の病だったとしても、\n人から人にうつる類の病では無いとの事だ。\n: Even if they have that disease, it's not the kind that spreads from person to person. It might be wise to focus on defense at first.
m920120.企んでいるとは人聞きが悪い。\n君らが勝手に我ら邪仙の領地に侵入したんじゃないか: Saying we're scheming sounds harsh. Perhaps it's you who trespassed into our domain without permission. It would be a bother if everything were blamed on us.
m920120.何を……何を言っているんですかァ？\n太公望、病でその判断力すら失いましたか！: What… what are you saying?! Taigong Wang, have you lost your judgment from your illness!
m920120.何？ いや、それは完全に誤解――: What? No, that's a complete misunderstanding—
m920120.先日は慌ただしいお礼しか出来なかったので、\n改めてお礼を言わねばと思いまして…: The other day I could only thank you in a rush, so I thought I should properly express my gratitude again…
m920120.分かってはいるんです。\nでもやはり、ハクタク様の力に頼るだけでは、いつか\n皆:
I understand that.
But still, if I keep relying only on Haku-taku's power, someday I'll end up holding everyone back…
m920120.動物さんではありません。\nかの幻獣こそ、森羅万象に通ずる智慧を持ち、\n病魔と: It's not an animal. That phantom beast possesses wisdom that spans all of creation—it is Hakutaku himself, who is said to purge disease and calamity.
m920120.君達も例の病が発症しているんだろう？ ん？\nいやぁ、同情するねぇ……。\n王国:
You all are showing the symptoms of that disease, aren't you? Huh?
Well, I feel sorry for you…
Even the kingdom's finest can't beat this illness.
m920120.幸い、私達はハクタクの住処の伝承を知っています。\nごほっ、けほっ……この病さえ:
Fortunately, we know the legend of Hakutaku's dwelling.
*hack* *cough*… If we can cure this illness,
we'll be in perfect condition to face the Evil Immortal.
m920120.弓矢はおろか、魔法すらも防ぐ砂の護り。\nあの砂を貫けるような攻撃があれば良いの: It even blocks arrows and magic with its sand shield. If only we had an attack that could pierce that sand… Anyway, let's focus our assaults from outside the “Calamity Blood Formation.”
m920120.彼らの様子は気になりますが……。\nいずれにせよ、応戦はしなければなりません。\: Their condition worries me… Anyway, we have to fight back. Prince, please take charge of the interception!
m920120.急ぎの用ではなかったし、構わないさ。\n引き合わせたい者が居たんだが、\n後回し:
It wasn't urgent, so it's fine.
I have someone I want you to meet, but it looks like it'll have to wait.
m920120.慣れない行軍を続けているんだ。\n急ぐ旅とはいえ、少し休憩を取ったほうが――っと: We've been on an unfamiliar march. Even on a hurried journey, we should take a short break—wait, ugh… something's off… I'm feeling unwell too.
m920120.我らが女王、ドロテア様から\nあなたに協力するように言われているの。\n実力を見: Our queen, Lady Drothea, has ordered you to assist her. It's perfect timing to see your strength.
m920120.戦いについては素人ですが、\nそれでも、ハクタク様から授かったこの力、\n困って: I'm a novice when it comes to battle, but still, I want to use this power granted by Hakutaku-sama to help those in need.
m920120.手間をかけるな、王子。\n説教は後であいつにしてやってくれ。: Don't trouble yourself, Prince. Save the lecture for him later.
m920120.教え子の為に必死になれるなら、\nカリンは立派な教師に違いないさ。: If you can be that desperate for your pupil, Karin must be a fine teacher.
m920120.教え子の病を治そうと、\n遠路はるばるあの村を訪ねてきたんだろう？: You came all the way to that village to cure your pupil's illness, didn't you?
m920120.教え子の身を案じる優しき心、\n戦う力を持たぬにも関わらず、\n怖れることなくこ: A gentle heart that worries for one's pupils, courage to walk this road without fear despite lacking the strength to fight.
m920120.民を守護せんとする志、人を導くに相応しきものなり。\nこの娘に我が魔祓いの力を貸: A resolve to protect the people, worthy of guiding others. I shall grant this girl my exorcising power. Use it to uphold justice—
m920120.王国の軍の皆様はそれぞれが厳しい訓練を積み、\n人々を守るために戦っていますよね: The kingdom's soldiers all undergo rigorous training, fighting to protect the people.
m920120.王子、ここで足止めをされている時間はありません。\n迅速に魔物の群れを迎撃しまし: Prince, we don't have time to linger here. Let's swiftly intercept the monster horde!
m920120.王子、オーク達は病で弱っているようですが、\n体力が失われる程に凶暴化するため、: Prince, the orcs are weakened by the disease, but they become more ferocious as they lose stamina, so we can't let our guard down. Please command us carefully!
m920120.王子、追撃しよう。\nあいつらが病を蔓延させたんだ。\nここで見逃したら……くっ:
Prince, let's give chase.
They're the ones spreading the disease.
If we let them get away now… *cough* *cough*…
m920120.王子も身体がお辛いかとは思いますが、\n私達を信じて待ってくれている方々がいます: Prince, I know you're feeling unwell, but there are people counting on us, believing in us. Stay strong and let's push forward.
m920120.王子様！ 尊天君と淵天君が現れました！: Your Highness! Sonten and Futen-kun have appeared!
m920120.王子殿下、太公望様、王国の皆さんも、\n本当にありがとうございました……！:
Prince, Lord Taigong, everyone in the kingdom,
thank you so much…!
m920120.王子殿下の、人々を救う為の戦いに、\n私も連れて行ってはいただけませんか……？: Could you take me along in your fight to save the people…?
m920120.病の出処も含め、\n今後も警戒が必要なようですね……。\n王子、ひとまず王国へ帰: Including the source of the illness, we'll need to stay on guard from now on… Prince, let's return to the kingdom for now.
m920120.病を操る宝貝とやら、\n我が電絶陣の力に比すれば児戯のようなものだと\n思ってい: That so-called disease-controlling treasure shell… compared to the power of my Electro-Null Formation, it's child's play, but it's oddly entertaining.
m920120.知り合いも何も、用事っていうのが\n王子とあいつを引き合わせることだったんだ。\: It wasn't about acquaintances at all—my job was to bring the Prince and that guy together. I thought he'd vanished out of nowhere… honestly…
m920120.確かにこの気配、近くに魔物がいるようです。\nカリンさんは後ろに下がっていてくだ: Indeed, I sense a monster nearby. Karin, please stay back.
m920120.確かに王子が前線にいるのは、\n珍しいかもしれませんね……。\nでも、ずっとこう: It is indeed rare for the Prince to be on the front… But we've been fighting like this all along!
m920120.私は……あの子達の、先生ですからね。\n村に残してきた教え子の為にも、\nここで:
I'm… their teacher, after all.
I can't just abandon them for the sake of the pupils I left behind in the village.
m920120.私も立ち会っていましたが、どうにもこの病、\n邪仙の用いる病を操る術に\n症状が: I was there myself, and this sickness feels a lot like the disease-manipulating technique used by the Evil Immortal.
m920120.私を、王国の皆さんの仲間に加えてほしいのです。: I'd like you to let me join the kingdom's ranks.
m920120.素直なんだか素直じゃないんだか……まぁいい。\n王子、こいつはジルヴァ、魔界都市: Whether you're being honest or not… whatever. Prince, this is Zilva, the warden of the demon-city prison. By the queen's command, she'll be cooperating with the kingdom from now on.
m920120.自ら病毒の最も深き場所へ進むとは、\nどうやら本当に、ハクタクだなんて、\n架空: To venture into the deepest part of the virus themselves… seems they really are clinging to the fairy tale of Hakutaku…
m920120.自分たちの欲望の為だけに、\n子供らや多くの民を苦しめた邪仙の目論見、\nここで: For the sake of our own desires they've tormented children and countless people—this evil sage's scheme. Let's defeat them here, Prince!
m920120.自分に出来る精一杯を頑張る事が助け合う事だって、\n太公望さんや王子様たちから教: I learned from Taigong Wang and the Prince that doing your best and helping each other is what matters. …So please don't think that way, Karin.
m920120.自分の力に相応しい者が来るのを待っていた……。\nそう、仰っています。\n今こそ: He says he's been waiting for someone worthy of his power… that's what he's saying. Now is the time to lend us his strength…
m920120.良いじゃないか、無価値な有象無象が、\n価値ある実験の糧になれるのだから。: It's fine—worthless scum can become the fuel for a valuable experiment.
m920120.薬の効かない病……それではカリンさんの村も、\nわたしの村と同じ病が流行している: An untreatable disease… So Karin's village is suffering the same plague as mine. Unfortunately, even feng-shui can't cure it…
m920120.見過ごせなかった？ 裏取引を？: Couldn't ignore it? A back-room deal?
m920120.話は通じそうにないですね……。\nオークの軍勢がこちらへ向かってきます！: It doesn't look like they'll listen… The orc army is marching toward us!
m920120.謎の病、ですか……。\nそれで私達に応援要請をしたのですね。: A mysterious illness, huh… So you're asking us for help?
m920120.迅天君、配下への出撃指示を出したようです！\n王子、迎撃の指揮をお願いします！: Jinten's given the order to send his troops out! Prince, take command of the interception!
m920120.迅天君の操る電絶陣には、\n人を麻痺させる力があります。十分に警戒を。: Jinten's Electro-Null Formation can paralyze people. Stay on guard.
m920120.邪仙、狛天君……！？\nどうしてこの場所に……ま、まさか\n先回りされていたとい: Jasen, Komaten…!? How did you get here… could it be—were you already one step ahead!?
m920120.邪仙が作り出した宝貝……。\nなるほど、だから邪仙たるあなたは、\nこの病の影響: The treasure shell created by the Evil Immortal… I see, so you, as an Evil Immortal, aren't affected by the disease.
m920120.邪仙の軍勢、撤退していきます……。: The evil sage's army is retreating…
m920120.（――ほう？ こいつら我らの研究施設へ、\n真っ直ぐに向かってくるみたいだな……: (—Hmm? Looks like they're heading straight for our research facility…)
m920120.（まさか場所を知っているのか？\nそれともあの、うさんくさい\n『おとぎ話』を信: (Do they actually know the location? Or are they following that shady “fairy tale”…?)

m920169.(ルチアと同じチームに……いや、しかし): (On the same team as Lucia… no, but)
m920169.……あっ！ しまった！？\n戦いに魅入ってしまっていた！？:
……Ah! I forgot!
I was completely caught up in the fight!
m920169.……お前はそういうやつだったよ。: ……So that's the kind of person you are, huh.
m920169.……すまないルチア、先行してくれ。\nキュウビ様を起こして私も後から追いつく。:
...I'm sorry, Lucia. You go ahead.
I'll wake Kyuubi and catch up with you later.
m920169.……そうなのか、わかった。\nそれと、ありがとうレギーナさん。:
...I see. Understood.
And thank you, Regina.
m920169.……で、テメェらなんでここにいるんだ？: ……So, why are you guys still here?
m920169.……また面倒なことになっておるのぉ。\n適当に真面目な連中についていくとするか。:
……We're in for trouble again.
I'll just tag along with the serious bunch for now.

Let's hunt the nearby beasts and gather water and food.

m920169.ぜーはー、ぜーはー！\nこっ、殺されるかと思いました……！:

Well, that settles our next destination.
Let's start making preparations right away.

Oh, right! It was hot when we went there

m920169.そして何よりご飯がおいしい。: And above all, the food is delicious.

Everyone, bring me the finest ingredients!

m920169.それじゃあ行こうか王子、グルメジャングルへ！: Then let's go, Prince! To the Gourmet Jungle!

The team that earned the prestigious first place is──

Draconex dried meat.

Going to a place like that just for me.

Please rest assured… The people of the Eastern Lands
can turn any ingredient into a feast…

fled in terror? I've never heard of anything so unprecedented.
m920169.なら早速、ハンティングスタートだな。: Then let's not waste time. Hunting begins now.

Hahaha, Meer, hahaha.

No one goes home until we've collected a hundred shark fins.
m920169.ははは！ 了解した、貴方も相変わらずだな。: Hahaha! Got it. You're still the same as ever.

m920169.ふん、それもあの鮫のお陰で、\n全て徒労になったようだがな……。: Hmph. It's all for nothing now, thanks to that shark…

Hm. You look like a powerhouse,

Meer, guide us to the sandworms' location.

We've also gathered some worm meat, so it's not too late to give up yet.
m920169.まあ確かに、勝つにはそれしか方法はないか……。: Well, you're right. That might be our only chance to win...

But it's first come, first served. The horse and dragon meat are ours—
m920169.むぅ、スタートダッシュは王子が先頭か？: Hmph, the Prince is in the lead from the start?

Oh my, we've gotten quite worked up.

and see if we can find another team to cooperate with.
m920169.アげていくぜェええええええええッ！！！: I'm going to keep pushing you!!

Oh, oh, oh, oh! What a coincidence!

m920169.キュウビ様……そろそろ降りてもらえませんか？: Kyuubi... could you please get down soon?

Shaaaaack!!

Shaaaaaarrrrrk!!

m920169.断る。わらわは歩きとうない、眠い。: No. I don't feel like walking. I'm sleepy.

Fine print is unnecessary. I'll trust everyone's conscience.

m920169.視線は雄弁ですからね。そうでなくとも、\n食材集めを手伝ってくれていたのでしょう:

Our share will be smaller, but I think we should cooperate!

???: ――T-Traitor!

??? : ――Oh my?
